title: Mass automated login attempts hit Germany's BundID citizen accounts; password login suspended, later restored with two-factor authentication
what_changed: Title and summary no longer state flatly that accounts were blocked: Tichys Einblick (18 November) reports the Digital Ministry later said there was no explicit blocking. Added that password login was suspended (dpa, citing the BSI) and later restored with two-factor authentication (Tichys Einblick); removed an unsourced 12:00 occurred_at.
